P.name: Mark of the Storm
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: The third stack against a target consumes them all to {{tip|stun}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and restore {{sti|{{as|25 energy}}}}. The stun duration is reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds if this occurs on the same target again within 6 seconds.
P.description3: ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} can apply only up to 3 stacks on a target.''

Q.name: Thundering Shuriken
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.

W.name: Electrical Surge
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a stack of ''Electrical Surge'', stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes all stacks to both deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a stack of ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|140|40}}|critical damage}} damage.
'''Kennen''' gains maximum stacks of ''Electrical Surge'' upon [[death|respawning]].
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' sends out a surge of electricity that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies afflicted by ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' or within ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}}''.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80 to 120}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
W.description3: ''An enemy within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 775 units with {{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}} or inside {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''

E.name: Lightning Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' turns into lightning for 2 seconds, becoming unable to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|100% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. He deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 65% against non-champions, and restores {{sti|{{as|40 energy}}}} upon damaging at least one enemy.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|80*0.65 to 240*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: ''Lightning Rush'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kennen''' ends ''Lightning Rush'' to gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and be allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} by the amount gained for 4 seconds. {{tip|Critical strikes}} extend the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed's}} duration by 1 second, up to the original duration.
E.description4: ''Lightning Rush's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

R.name: Slicing Maelstrom
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' summons a storm around himself for 3 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for the duration.
R.description2: The storm strikes lightning bolts down on nearby enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
R.description3: ''Slicing Maelstrom'' gains 10% additional damage for each subsequent strike a target has received, up to a combined total of 150% of the initial strike's damage.
R.description4: '''''Kennen''' can move during Slicing Maelstrom's cast time.''
